title: Porridge with berries
toddlerSplit: Make theirs looser and let it stand — porridge holds heat and burns small mouths. Honey only for the 3-year-old.
steps: Oats and milk in the pan, 1 part oats to 3 parts milk. Simmer 5 minutes, stirring.
Toddlers' bowls first, loosened with a splash of cold milk so they can eat straight away.
